sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [G]Look for the way-marks as you journey [D7]on,
[G]Look for the way-marks passing one by one;
[G]Down through the ages, past the kingdoms four—
[G]Where are [Em]we standing? Look the way-marks o’er.

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [D]Look for the way-marks, the [G/D]great prophetic way-marks,
[Am]Down through the ages, past the kingdoms four.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [G]Down in the feet of iron and [D7]of clay,
[G]Weak and divided, soon to pass away;
[G]What will the next great, glorious drama be?
